in_marathi.name: Nridesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nridesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nridesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nr' which means 'Lord' and 'is' which means 'of the universe'. This name represents the supreme power and is revered in Hinduism. The name is also associated with the deity Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of the universe.
